name: cli_show_hierarchy
description: Example: Mobility Conductor CLI session that runs `no paging` then `show configuration node-hierarchy`. Uses the simulated terminal (black bg, light green text). Swap the `print_output` lines for your real SecureCRT log.
narration: The A-O-S eight Mobility Conductor gives you full visibility into configuration hierarchy and inheritance. [[slnc 500]] From the Mobility Conductor C-L-I, you can print the whole tree with two commands. [[slnc 600]] First, type 'no paging' to disable output pagination, [[slnc 1000]] so the hierarchy prints in one pass. [[slnc 500]] Then run 'show configuration node hierarchy'. [[slnc 1400]] The output walks the tree from the system root down, listing each config node with its type and name. [[slnc 500]] Groups define inheritance boundaries. Devices sit under the group they inherit from, identified by their Mac address. [[slnc 500]] Reading this top to bottom is how you capture the A-O-S eight hierarchy before replicating or redesigning it in Central.
